name: static-radial-gradient
description: Static WebGL shader background in the Static Radial Gradient style. Default variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 4-color palette (#08051A, #3A0CA3, #F72585, #FFD6FF). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
